sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): darting forward in his low ready stance, the pale curved blade held low in the bare hand on the viewer's left, the brown glove forward, the LEGS CHANGING OVER as written for each frame
sheets.weapons: THE BLADE AND THE SWORD go where the pale figure has them, frame by frame (image 3 shows them in colour): the pale curved blade in the bare hand on the viewer's left - held low, raised over his head, slashed out, swept or swung back as the pale figure holds it (beside him on the ground when he dies); the sword on his back with the light blue gem on its hilt stays where the pale figure has it. The hood with its silver points, the grey mask and the shoulder pads stay on him. Only him: no spirit blade, no ki, no shields, no zones, no dash streaks, no glow.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) straight down under his hips, his brown boot flat on the ground line; the FAR leg (the darker one) bent and kicked back behind him, its foot off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot low, just off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must show a different leg planted. Draw the legs AS WRITTEN for each frame, not the pale figure's (the old 1x legs are too small to read; runs drawn after them kept the same legs in all 8 frames: 「走路没有换腿」). The body, the head, the hood, the blade and the sword follow the pale figure. The blade is NOT a leg: his two legs carry him.
